text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm walking by the academy
shop...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Brrr... I'm so cold...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Enough of your whining, Doto.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Have a glance at what lies behind us!
There are
still a hundred packs of ice
cream to get through!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
O-okay...
I'll do what I can to eat them...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What in the?! There's no reason to eat
them all!
Are you trying to clear out the
ice cream shelves
or something?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Wah, Fukukitaru? B-but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
We won't get the special prize if we
don't eat all
the ice cream bars...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Special prize?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Whoever finds the winning stick will
win the
special prize—a Super Snug
Carrot Blanket.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It's a first-rate item that does away with
all your
aches and fatigue in a single
day's re—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Urgh?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: King?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...I am bowing out from the mission
temporarily!
This is not me admitting
defeat, mind y—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Urk... Urrrghhh!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: KIIIIING?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... What to do now? No... I need
to keep
eating...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Riddle me this, Doto. What if... and this
is purely
hypothetical...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What if you eat a hundred and don't find
the
winning stick? Wouldn't it be better
to stop while
you can?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If that were to happen... actually, if it
does
happen—we'd just go to another
shop to buy
more.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I may be useless, but if I find that
winning stick... I
could, just maybe,
achieve anything I want.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I don't... want to be this way forever.
Bad
at
everything...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I want to learn to love myself and
become an
Umamusume who can give it
her all!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So you're making a prayer of
sorts.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Then our meeting today must be the
work of fate! I shall supply you with a
pile of lucky charms to
help you find a
winning ice cream stick!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: F-Fukukitaru!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No problem! I'll go to the classroom and
get
everything to you in a jiffy! I've even
got my prized lucky charm—a winning
ice cream stick that I got ten years ago!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, uh... Th-thank you very much?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Meisho Doto continues to
eat her
ice cream bars as
Matikanefukukitaru cheers her
on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They would probably get through the
ice cream bars a lot quicker together,
but I choose not to
interfere. That's
when...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I... I found it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto successfully wins the Super
Snug
Carrot Blanket and puts it straight
to use the
following day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Recovering from excessive
consumption of ice
cream.
